rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the maximum annual rent increase is 1.6% of base rent for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (1.4% the prior year). Multiply base rent by .016 to get the maximum dollar increase.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the current annual allowable-increase period (announced 2026-01-14); the ordinance itself is older and the percentage resets each March 1.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled units; units with a certificate of occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the rent increase limits (per D079).

unverifiable_exemptions: units regulated by other government agencies

rules.review_note: The cutoff date comes from D079 (just-cause overview), which says post-June 13, 1979 CO units are exempt from the rent increase limits.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance just cause eviction and relocation payments
rules.requirement: A landlord of a covered unit may evict only for one of 17 listed just causes, and the just cause must be the dominant motive. Lease expiration or a change in ownership is not just cause. For no-fault evictions the landlord must pay relocation, which is $8,245 per tenant for notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027.
rules.key_value: 17 just causes; relocation (notices 3/1/26–2/28/27): $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, +$5,497 per elderly/disabled/minor-child household; Ellis Act: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13, +$7,443.90
rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction
rules.effective_date_note: No effective date for the just-cause provisions in the documents. The relocation amounts in key_value took effect 2026-03-01 and adjust each March 1.
rules.penalty: Unlawful or attempted eviction may bring substantial civil and/or criminal liability.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the Rent Ordinance. Includes some units exempt from the rent increase limits (post-June 13, 1979 CO units, Costa-Hawkins-eligible tenancies, some government-regulated tenancies).
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 ($446/day plus moving expenses), not § 37.9C.
rules.interaction: Applies even to tenancies exempt from the Ordinance's rent increase limits.

unverifiable_exemptions: tenancies in units regulated by other government agencies
owner-occupancy and other exemptions under the Rent Ordinance

rules.review_note: Relocation schedules (§ 37.9C and Ellis Act § 37.9A) come from D082/D083 and are folded into this record.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords and vendors may not sell or use algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents or manage occupancy. Tenants or the City Attorney can sue. Remedies include damages, injunctions and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each unit-month a separate violation.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor rental data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of such algorithmic devices and allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law
rules.effective_date_note: Per SF.gov (D081): went into effect October 14, 2024. Law-firm sources say only 'October 2024'.
rules.penalty: Civil action by a tenant or the City Attorney; damages, injunctive relief, civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, each unit-month separate

rules.title: SF security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.citation: S.F. Rent Board security deposit interest rate
rules.quoted_span:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.effective_date_note: Start of the rate period stated in the document; the rate resets each March 1.
rules.review_note: The document gives the rate but not the code section that requires interest, so no section is cited.

parsed.notes: San Francisco has four final records. Duplicate algorithmic-ban candidates (c68, c78, c91) and the duplicate rent-increase candidates (c67, c70) were merged. The just-cause record folds in the § 37.9C and Ellis Act § 37.9A relocation schedules (c69, c71, c72). No source describes a city-level rule on application fees or screening restrictions. D078 only names the Fair Chance Ordinance without stating what it requires, so no record or no-rule finding was added for those categories.
